messages:
alex: deploy-bot just alerted a canary p95 jump for the dedicated pool — 50% traffic. seeing p95 ~420ms, threshold 200ms. no 5xx spike yet but latencies are customer-visible. should we let autopilot handle it or intervene?

deploy-bot: SYSTEM: CanaryTelemetry: p95=420ms (>200ms), canary_traffic=50%. Autorevert=false (policy=dedicated_manual). Suggested action: HOLD rollout, consider pin to previous model variant.

maya: looking at logs. no increase in 5xx, just slower responses on long-context prompts. hints at kernel/kv-cache path.

sre-oncall: confirmed — CPU on the serving hosts for dedicated pool spiked when seq_len>2048. model tag=rw/infer-v3.2.1-quant. previous stable is rw/infer-v3.2.0. recommend manual rollback/pin for dedicated customers.

dan: agree with manual rollback. we should also update release notes and prep a short customer blurb. @release-bot can you open the rollback ticket and pin action?

release-bot: Created ticket RWBK-4421: "Rollback dedicated pool -> pin rw/infer-v3.2.0". Assigned to @maya and @sre-oncall. Link: https://tickets.internal/RWBK-4421

alex: Plan: 1) pause rollout (deployctl pause --rollout 98765) 2) pin dedicated routing to rw/infer-v3.2.0 3) monitor p95 for 10m 4) notify affected customers and update release notes.

lucy: I'll draft the customer note. short, factual: "We reverted to a previous model to reduce latency; investigating root cause; will follow up with timeline."

maya: executing now. running: 
```
deployctl pause --rollout 98765
deployctl set-pin --pool dedicated --model rw/infer-v3.2.0 --reason "latency regression v3.2.1"
```

maya: pinned and rolled traffic back to v3.2.0 for dedicated pool. currently routing 100% to v3.2.0.

sre-oncall: telemetry: p95 now 178ms, tail looks back to normal. no new 5xx. continuing to monitor for 15m.

dan: great. alex can you add a short note to the release notes: "rolled back dedicated pool from v3.2.1 to v3.2.0 due to latency regression on long-context requests" and flag for postmortem.

alex: added to release notes and created PM-flag for postmortem.

lucy: customer note posted to status page + emailed affected customers.

deploy-bot: SYSTEM: RolloutUpdate: rollout 98765 -> paused. traffic set to rw/infer-v3.2.0 (100%). Canary disabled. p95=178ms.

maya: monitoring: all green for 10m. will keep watch and collect kernel traces for root cause.

sre-oncall: creating trace collection ticket and linking to RWBK-4421.

dan: moving to postmortem template after traces. big :thumbsup: to quick manual intervention.

alex: closing this thread for now — we'll reopen if regressions reoccur. :white_check_mark:"
